fyne

fyne Components
  • Button
  • Check
  • Container
  • DateEntry The picker shows its `placeholder` and neither reads the bound value nor reports a selection: Fyne has no date widget among those wrapped here, so the Label is a stub standing in for one rather than a picker whose value has nowhere to go.
  • Entry
  • Flow A flow of spans, as a node.
  • Grid A grid of `columns` equal columns, its children laid out a row at a time.
  • HBox
  • Hyperlink `widget.Hyperlink` exposes its text and its URL as struct fields rather than as setters, and a URL is a `*url.Parse` result rather than an expression this package can spell, so the link renders empty.
  • Image --- Images --- An image is this platform's runtime and not a Fyne widget: a box holding the source it shows, fitted as `fit` says, or the placeholder where it holds none.
  • ImageDrawing
  • ImageUrl
  • Label
  • MultiLineEntry
  • ReachScroll A vertical scroll reporting the end of its content coming within half a viewport of showing (pkg/go/fynelayout's ReachScroll): Fyne reports a scroll and nothing about the content growing, which is what a handler adding a page does.
  • Select `options` must be assigned before `selected`: `SetSelected` ignores a value that is not already among `Options`, and the props are assigned in the order this call writes them.
  • Spacer
  • Span One run of words.
  • Toplevel A toplevel: the host object a `ui.window` is on this platform.
  • VBox
  • VScroll
  • Widget
  • Wrapper
  • markup.image Fyne has an image segment and it is a block -- "images in rich text are blocks", says its own comment -- so there is no picture to put on the line with the words.
  • markup.link
  • markup.richText
  • markup.run
  • markup.text
  • markup.token
  • platform The `fyne` node of a build directive: `output { go { fyne() } }`.
  • shapes.image
  • time.timer Two effects, because a schedule and its period have two lifetimes.
  • ui.button
  • ui.card A clickable card is its box shown in a fynelayout.Tap, the widget Fyne hands a tap to: a box is drawn and never tapped.
  • ui.checkbox
  • ui.datepicker
  • ui.divider
  • ui.drawer
  • ui.file
  • ui.hbox
  • ui.image
  • ui.input
  • ui.link `href` and `text` are not forwarded — see the Hyperlink declaration.
  • ui.menu
  • ui.menubar
  • ui.modal
  • ui.popover
  • ui.progress `value` is a float and the label is text, so the conversion is spelled here rather than left to the Spec, which binds a prop to a setter and converts nothing.
  • ui.radio
  • ui.remote
  • ui.scroll
  • ui.select
  • ui.spacer
  • ui.spinner
  • ui.splitview
  • ui.stack Fyne has no layered container in the widget set this platform builds from, so a stack is a vertical box: the children are all present and in order, they just do not overlap.
  • ui.table A table is a grid of labels a column per heading, the headings first and then each row's cells, so a cell lines up under its heading.
  • ui.text
  • ui.textarea
  • ui.toggle Fyne's Check is the switch affordance too: `widget.Switch` is not in the widget set this platform builds from.
  • ui.toolbar
  • ui.tooltip The shape html uses: a box carrying the tooltip text, with the wrapped content inside it.
  • ui.tree
  • ui.vbox
  • ui.window The window's `@error` is the outermost boundary of what it renders, and catches whether or not the call site handles one.
    • Types
  • Arg One argument to a widget's Go constructor.
  • Handler The Go callback field one declared event is assigned to.
  • Native Everything the Go emitter needs to build one Fyne widget.
  • Schedule `*time.Ticker` is a name this declaration can spell, which is what `#[cnative]` does for `*C.cairo_t` in gtk4.sngl, one scheme over -- and `C` is a field of it, which is why `sngl:language/go` had to grow a channel type before any of this could be written down.
  • Setter The Go setter method one value prop becomes: `Setter{prop="text", call="SetText"}` emits `w.SetText(v)`.
